all_found.desc: [BUG] UninstallHookInstall unsets core.hooksPath then ignores EVERY error from unsetting metareview.stopGate and returns success; only git's missing-key exit (5) is benign. Raised by CodeRabbit on PR #195. If the opt-in cannot be removed (config lock, permission), --uninstall-hooks reports uninstalled while pre-finish.sh keeps gating sessions, since it checks metareview.stopGate independently of core.hooksPath.

findings.consequence: If the opt-in cannot be removed (config lock, permission), --uninstall-hooks reports uninstalled while pre-finish.sh keeps gating sessions, since it checks metareview.stopGate independently of core.hooksPath.
findings.issue: UninstallHookInstall unsets core.hooksPath then ignores EVERY error from unsetting metareview.stopGate and returns success; only git's missing-key exit (5) is benign. Raised by CodeRabbit on PR #195.

findings.consequence: A rare partial uninstall leaves the opt-in set with the obvious retry reporting success.
findings.issue: When UninstallHookInstall returns (true, err) the CLI prints only the bare error (without git's stderr) and exits 1, not saying core.hooksPath was already unset; a re-run then finds core.hooksPath empty, prints 'nothing to uninstall' and exits 0 while metareview.stopGate survives.
